title: Dear Prudence
tuning: D A D G B E
feel: Fingerpicked: thumb on the bass, fingers alternating on top; about 110 bpm (estimate)

alt_voicings.label: Ethan Hein's reading
alt_voicings.note: for D/B and D/B♭: leave the 3rd string open; compare by ear

sections.name: Verse loop
sections.note: Descending bass D–C–B–B♭. The verse's crux moves to C – G – D (♭VII–IV–I), with Dsus4 decorations.

sections.name: Bridge
sections.note: Repeated as on the record, then:

why: **Drop D**, a **descending bass under a held top**, and independent thumb/finger picking.
hard_change: **D/B → D/B♭** while keeping the picking pattern unbroken: only the 5th-string finger moves.
theory: I over a D pedal with a chromatic bass. ♭VII (C) gives Mixolydian colour; the bridge's F and A♭ are ♭III and ♭V.
steps: Retune to drop D. The verse loop alone, slowly, thumb only.
With the picking pattern at 70% (Lauren Bateman teaches it at 80 bpm).
